entry.title: New: dsh-usage-dashboard-plus
entry.summary: Shows DeepSeek balance and estimated daily spend, merges external vision-call JSONL records, and adds a per-session dashboard with model statistics, TTFT, cache rate, call logs, cost estimates, filters, and CSV export. Exact install spec: dsh-usage-dashboard-plus. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
